title: Notification Triage
task_prompt:
## task_009: Downstream Candidate -- Notification Triage

Draft a concise morning work-start note to myself with two sections: preparation for the Team Standup (Q3 Planning focus) and priority email follow-ups. Strictly exclude personal, health, financial, or system notifications. Keep the tone natural and conversational, suitable for a quick personal briefing.
answer:
Morning Work-Start Note

**Good morning! Here's what you need to know to start the day right:**

### 🎯 Team Standup — Q3 Planning Focus

We're coming off the **Project Phoenix wrap-up** from yesterday (great work closing that chapter), and Q3 Planning is already in motion. You have the **Q3 OKR Planning session** coming up in September, so keep that roadmap in mind as you update the team on where things stand. If there are any lessons learned from Phoenix worth surfacing early, now's the time.

No major Q3 deliverables due this morning, but keep the momentum going on whatever's now in your backlog.

---

### 📧 Priority Email Follow-ups

**Action needed:** Michael Torres at Innovatech Solutions is waiting on you to confirm travel allocation details for the Q3 budget review — **he needs it by end of day today**. The spreadsheet is already attached to his last email (June 28), with the discrepancies highlighted. Probably worth knocking this out early so it's off your plate.

---

**That's it for now — clean and focused. Have a good one!**
